propositions: A removal record for a managed link with no peer confirmation should be declined without writing an UNLINK event, and _inbound_unlink_one must return False to keep the silent-no-op canary truthful

The outbound ADD dedup on (vendor_type, target_key) can mask a local link from re-ADD protection (G4) when its vendor type collides with an existing remote link in the opposite direction, causing an unprotected removal record to reach the applier

A confirmation store should be opened once per pass in _inbound_update_apply_links and threaded into _inbound_unlink_one; if unopenable (None), the check disables and restoration behavior matches pre-story state (fail-open contract)
A removal record for a link WITH a peer confirmation must still converge via relation-scoped unlink, and backfill-sourced confirmations must allow removal on the first post-upgrade pass
The per-pass INFO summary must report decline counts so operator visibility matches impossible-link skip reporting
Re-applying a declined removal record on a later pass must decline again idempotently and write nothing
